title: Local governance reference plugins
description: 實作 upstream 預設治理套件，讓空白 repo 不依賴 3KLife 也能使用 task、lock、doc index、shard、artifact、log、rule guard 與 evidence workflow。
acceptance: 空白 repo 可用 atm init / atm bootstrap 建立 canonical .atm governance layout
bootstrap / self-hosting alpha smoke 維持綠燈
local governance smoke fixture 驗證 .atm/artifacts、.atm/logs、.atm/reports 與其他 canonical stores
reference plugins 不被 packages/core 直接 import
reference plugins 標記為 alpha1 gate，不阻塞 alpha0
version-history / human-review reference plugins 標記為 alpha1，不阻塞 alpha0 release

title: Official Review Advisory Provider (AI Code Reviewer, non-blocking)
description: 補上 deterministic validate 之外的語意式 code review advisory layer，但只作建議，不直接決定 pass/fail。
acceptance: review scope 可來自 changed file list、git diff、upgrade proposal、registry diff 或指定 atom/map 範圍
provider 可以是 stub、agent-bridge、external-cli，core 不直接依賴 vendor SDK
report / evidence 必須能映射到 .atm/reports/* 與 EvidenceStore contract
deterministic validate chain 仍維持單獨可跑，不依賴 advisory provider 可用性
host 端可以用 agent skill / subagent / editor tool 去接入，但那只是 adapter 實作，不是 framework semantic requirement
